description: Re-analysis of eval A restricted to WAVE 0 -- the only subset with outcome-independent pairing. LIBERO-Plus advances init_state_id by n_envs per reset, and a terminated episode triggers TWO resets, so each arm's wave-1 initial states depend on its own wave-0 successes. Wave 0 (first 8 of 15 episodes per task) is genuinely paired; wave 1 (remaining 7) is not. Derived from the per-episode seed/success records in the eval_A result.json files archived with the run outputs.

rs_sft_vs_sft.caveat: pairing is broken here; reported only to show where the full-sample significance came from

conclusion: On the genuinely paired subset the RS-SFT advantage is NOT significant (p=0.092; task-clustered CI includes zero). The point estimate is unchanged (42.9% vs 30.4%). The significance reported for the full 105 episodes rests substantially on wave 1, where the pairing assumption fails.
